opening.kicker: River Market · the Gate of Trust
opening.title: The gate opens
opening.text: The gatekeepers lift the great bar. “River Market speaks for you, and you weigh fairly,” the older one says. “The road east is yours.” Beyond the arch the river road runs out across the fields.
opening.go: Take the road east to Jisra

jisra.title: Jisra
jisra.text: The river road crosses here on a bridge of boats roped together, rising and falling with the water. Hamid the toll keeper sits at the near end with a wooden box. Nobody here knows your name.

toll.title: One coin and three
toll.text: A merchant in silk drops one coin in Hamid's box and leads his camels across. Behind him comes a family with a donkey and two tired children. Hamid holds up three fingers.
toll.out_speak: Hamid's face reddens. The boatmen are listening. He takes one coin from the family, the same as the merchant, and waves them on. He does not look at you again.
toll.out_pay: You drop three coins in the box. The mother thanks you. Hamid shrugs and pockets the difference - tomorrow the next poor family will pay three.
toll.out_quiet: The family pays three coins and crosses. The boatmen exchange a look. Nobody says anything.
